sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN standard message ID filter element
sections.text_helper: Section 71.4.22 "FDCAN standard message ID filter element" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3676.
sections.section_content:
Up to 128 filter elements can be configured for 11-bit standard IDs. When accessing a
standard message ID filter element, its address is the filter list standard start address
FDCAN_SIDFC.FLSSA plus the index of the filter element (0 … 127).
[Table 714. Standard message ID filter element]
[Table 715. Standard message ID filter element field description]
Note: In case a reserved value is configured, the filter element is considered disabled.
